name: Disneyland Bengal Barbecue Bengal Beef Skewer (Sweet Zulu Glaze) & Steamed White Rice
whyItWorks: Tender marinated sirloin beef cubes glazed in a mild, non-spicy sweet Zulu sauce over fluffy steamed white rice give you warm, fryer-free energy for walking the park.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bengal Beef Skewer (Sweet Zulu sauce—NOT the spicy Banyan sauce) with a side of plain steamed white rice, skipping the raw pickled citrus slaw on the plate.
watchOuts: Skip the raw pickled slaw on the Bengal Rice Plate (contains raw cabbage and citrus vinegar)
